1–3 hours (depends on the size of the team)

A mad mage built a tower in Edron to carry out experiments and his mechanical servants were overrun by fungi. Help {npc:Servant Sentry} clear the {item:Slime Fungus} from the dungeon with a {item:Slime Gobbler}, survive the waves of servants and kill the {creature:Mad Mage}. This is where you get items for the Elementalist outfit and the {item:Golden Can of Oil}.
A mad mage has built a tower in Edron to carry out experiments.
Ruined tower south of Stonehome, Edron
Each player has to clear at least **25 fungi** to be able to face the Mad Mage.
Friends: there are 350 fungi to clear and you can only clear one every 5 seconds
20 experience points for each fungus cleared
Chance to loot items for the {wiki:Elementalist Outfits|Elementalist} outfit
The state of this world change varies from world to world: the number of fungi in the dungeon depends on your world's state.
Go in a group: there are 350 fungi, each takes at least 5 seconds, and then hundreds of servants come.
If you are alone and clear the whole dungeon, you cannot leave until you finish: if you leave, the fungi return and the servants stop appearing.

Travel to **Edron**: in any city with a boat say {key:hi}, {key:edron} and {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. Leave the city on foot to the **east**/**northeast**, towards {wiki:Stonehome|Stonehome} (the small village northeast of Edron), and head **south** of Stonehome. You find a ruined tower. Cross the bridge and talk to the {npc:Servant Sentry}.
Map of Stonehome, northeast of Edron
Say {key:hi}, {key:help} and {key:yes}. The servant gives you a {item:Slime Gobbler}.
Going down to the main area
Go down **2 floors** to the dungeon's main area. Depending on your world's state, you will find {item:Slime Fungus} all over the place.
Using the Slime Gobbler on the fungi

Use the {item:Slime Gobbler} on each {item:Slime Fungus}. If you do it right, the floor is cleared and you gain 20 experience points. You can only remove **one fungus every 5 seconds** and there are **350** in total.

Each player has to clear at least **25 fungi** to be able to face the {creature:Mad Mage}. When you get there, the message *"You gobbled enough slime to get a good grip on this dungeon's slippery floor."* appears.

If you are on a team and another player kills the Mad Mage before you have cleared enough fungi, *"The mage has escaped, better start gobbling to face him again!"* appears and you have to clear fungi again to provoke a new Mad Mage.

When the dungeon is fully cleared, waves of servants start to appear: {creature:Iron Servant|Iron Servants}, {creature:Golden Servant|Golden Servants} and {creature:Diamond Servant|Diamond Servants}. A new wave starts **as soon as** all the servants of the previous wave die. A solo session has approximately:
Iron Servants appearing south of the entrance

You have to kill **all** the servants of each wave for the next one to appear. If you are alone, do not leave the dungeon: the fungi regenerate and the servants stop appearing. You can only re-enter if someone is still inside, and in that case the next wave restarts where it left off.
After all the waves, the {creature:Mad Mage} appears in one of three places, at random: the **north** corridor, the **far east** corridor or the **southeast** corridor. Kill him.
Chance to loot Elementalist outfit items and the {item:Golden Can of Oil}
When the Mad Mage dies, the fungi fill the dungeon again, waiting for the next player who wants to help the servants.
To leave, go back the same way: climb the **2 floors** to the ruined tower, cross the bridge and walk back **west** to **Edron** (the boat of {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities).
If you are alone and there are still waves left to kill, do not leave: the fungi regenerate and the servants stop appearing.
